items.title: File Widerspruch against the Kontenklärung decision
items.quote: Ein Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid ist binnen eines Monats nach dessen Bekanntgabe zulässig.
items.computation: Letter is dated 27.11.2025 (Thursday) and sent by a German social-insurance authority via ordinary post, so §37 Abs. 2 SGB X applies: it is deemed delivered (bekanntgegeben) on the third day after posting, unless proven otherwise. Counting from 27.11.2025 (day of posting not counted): 28.11. (Fri), 29.11. (Sat), 30.11. (Sun) = third day. Since the third day (30.11.2025) is a Sunday, §37 Abs. 2 SGB X shifts Bekanntgabe to the next business day, i.e. Monday 01.12.2025. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist then runs under §187 Abs. 1, §188 Abs. 2 BGB: the day of Bekanntgabe (01.12.2025) is not counted, the period starts the next day (02.12.2025) and ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the triggering event, i.e. 01.01.2026. 01.01.2026 (Neujahr) is a statutory public holiday in NRW (and nationwide), so under §193 BGB the deadline moves to the next business day: Friday, 02.01.2026, which is not a weekend day or holiday. Final deadline: 02.01.2026.
